create_engine_async_llm: create an AsyncLLMEngine from AsyncEngineArgs with aggregated stat loggers for multi-instance data parallel serving
run_data_parallel_inference: run async generate calls on an AsyncLLMEngine targeting a specific data parallel rank with sampling params
build_sampling_params: build SamplingParams with temperature, top_p, and max_tokens for LLM text generation
setup_background_logging: setup a background logging thread that periodically calls engine.do_log_stats until a stop event is set
configure_async_engine_args: configure AsyncEngineArgs with model, data parallel size, tensor parallel size, and RPC address for distributed serving
